content: Mrlx Kc Tqdrka'ngr Kc Kai Tqngi Enqmi Kc Etu Ngr Kraes

Zbz obq-rmwible-moux, x Mepwz sc tqtupe mepz prla tqaenzlipxpe. X mcx Mrlx Kc Tqdrka'ngr kx vzdzm prla. X nzyrtr-lxblrng mz narde rlimz drtq kx bletipx-lxblrng kx nzxtrnga-ngrdr Gct. X scde dxpa' nzpnu-esz', taplxsr kraon kxtopwz.

Mrlx Kc Tqdrka'ngr tqmcx apule trputi kzpeto kxetu. Drkrvi ngr nanycde boi x malc apule drkrvi ngr nanyc kzdq kz animol kzpeto. X nzxplrkr naode apule nao laion x nqngide malc. X rngisc zxplr, kraon x zmatq kx aprcbz Mepwz bade.
Opxm kx kzdq nar Mrlx Kc Tqdrka'ngr lcde nzataki pnz x ycpwz pipz nzbz-krde. A' mztitrpe x bzmrde sc tqyctxtr alo. Kx nzmclr Mrlx Kc Tqdrka'ngr, lr nrlc amrlx nzkctitxpxlr x sc tzvz-nqblqpelr natqde.

X nzangio-kzlr Mrlx Kc Tqdrka'ngr, mz nzrpi-krdr kx, “Trpnzngr kx rtakitr nzxplrkr Mrlx Kc Tqdrka'ngr. X trpnzngr kx yatrpz mz nzota-krdr ncdr murde na-aovxiole nide.” X nzangio-kzlr Mepwz murde nzaprc-krbzle zmatq mz Mrlx Kc Tqdrka'ngr.
Mrlx Kc Tqdrka'ngr napivxitiole Gct mz nzglqpx-lzbq-krde mz nzycmne-krde. A' zmatq lc nzrlrtx-ngrpwzlrle bade yiz tq x ncte kc.
Sc tqpibqtipele x tqlcbqtipele Gct, drtqde, me mnc-ngrde x lr Heven amrlx.
Nzrlr-ngrbz bade nzota-krdr badr leplz neng Gct x na-aovxioleng. X kxnzvzpxmqng mz nou, natq, neidu, x drtc' amrlx nzmnclzbzng mz zmatq ngrde.

Leplz mz nrlc tulvzo sa na-angiolr Mrlx Lc Tqdrka'ngr, krkcng drtqdr trnzyrou mz Buk ngr Nzlungr sc Nei Sip kc tznibq. A' kxnzrlxngiting kcng drtqdr tzyro elr abzo mzli kc tqwzngr Gct nrlc, trtxpnzngr Mrlx Lc Tqdrka'ngr.
Abzamu nzyrlq-angidr-krmu natq lcng navzm.

doa kx pnzpe drtwr Gct napresin, sa napresin. X kx pnzpe drtwr Gct nanibq mz toki r vea, sa nanibq mz toki r vea. Mz nzmu-krde lcde, mzli kc naprtz-ngrbz da lcng bamu, tu-amqngiamu mz nzrlxngiti-krmu x abrtrpzmu drtwrmu mz Gct.
Mrlx Kc Tqdrka'ngr Krali Tqngi Profet Kxpokia
Zbz mc-moux kzdq kz Mrlx Kxdrka'ngr kx vzdzm mz drtc'. Dxpa' krde li kxtopwz apule dxpa' kr Nei Sip, a' nzycmne-krde xplr apule nzycmnekr mepwz.
Mrlx Kc Tqdrka'ngr lc tutrpz mz krkc kai x zmatq ngrde apupwzle zmatq ngr krkc kai. X rtulrtr-ngrbzle mz lr nrlc amrlx nzangio-krdr Mrlx Kc Tqdrka'ngr kc kai tqyctrngr bzmr kxsqki.
Mrlx Lc Tqdrka'ngr krali, na-aletile rkx kxkqlu. Krlzle nzavzo-ngrm nyr bongavz mzli kc tzobqngr leplz kxkqlu.

Nzrlr-ngrbz mz Mrlx Kc Tqdrka'ngr krali nzaletr-krbzle rkx mz mz Mrlx Kc Tqdrka'ngr kc kai. X mz nzale-krde rkx lcng, esabrti-ngrde leplz kxkqlu mz nrlc. Krkc Krali pibzle badr nzrlz-krdr mqngr Krkc Kai tzataki mz toki r vea a' sc tqlupe mou, murde leplz na-angiolr nide mz mqngr kxnzlz lc.
X nzrlr-ngrbz mz Mrlx Kc Tqdrka'ngr krali nzvxutr-krbzle mz nao mqngr Mrlx Kc Tqdrka'ngr kc kai tzlzlr, murde naycmne, x nanibqtile leplz kcng trnzangiolru nide.
Mrlx Kc Tqdrka'ngr krali rtulrtr-ngrbzle mz leplz txneng, kxnzetung, bcnyrng, nra-nzlung, kxnzawz-nrbalqng x kx drtqdr opx nzyctrkr rkx mz mqdr kxrtc o mz rtrlrmztr.
Trpnzngr kx naxpe x na-amwa da, kx tr-rtwzkale rkx lc tqngi drtq Mrlx Kc Tqdrka'ngr kc kai o nabz kx ngi rkx ngr drtqde.

X nabz lcde trtqki-esz'mz-nzpnu-esz'mz-nrade-esz'mz (666). Doa kx drtwrde aotr-angidrbzle mz nabz lc, nide kx narmc drtwr ngr nabz sc Mrlx Lc Tqdrka'ngr, murde ngi nabz sc kzdq ncblo. Drtwrmu na-aotr-angidrbzmu mz da lcng murde naglx-angidramu nide mzli kc navzm.
